liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jack Straw opens the show, with increasingly thunderous drumming while the band lets Jerry storm ahead; Calls the Jack Straw tight [9][10]
- **Big River** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Big River, with Jerry's guitar and vocals sounding characteristic of the band; Says Jerry rips through Big River [8][10]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Jack Straw rolls straight into West L.A. Fadeaway [11]
- **Mama Tried** (1 review): Mama Tried features nice high-pitched cries from Jerry [9]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer highlights Bird Song as a standout of the show [13]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Singles out Iko Iko, along with Bird Song, Box of Rain and Eyes, as powerhouse versions [18]

## The recordings

- **gd88-04-14.sbd-patched.hinko.26283.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 142 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Says the vocals on the matrix sound really good, a possible hidden gem; Reviewer finds the recording sounds nasty, in a good way, early on [10][11]
- **gd1988-04-14.sbd.miller.91248.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 143 min; rated 4/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds stellar: strong Jerry vocals, a good mix, and Brent's keyboards clearly present [18]
- **gd1988-04-14.156481.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 145 min [3]
- **gd88-04-14.aud.willy.15824.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 135 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: Describes the audience recording as remote, low in treble and dirty, lacking crackle, which flattens the listening experience [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the show in Chicago and says it was so absorbing they forgot where they were [12]
- Attendee camped in a '79 Buick in chilly weather; jets kept landing at nearby O'Hare, and pilots wandered through the lot [19]
- Says the band was on fire throughout spring 1988 [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd88-04-14.sbd-patched.hinko.26283.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD (Matrix) > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [1]. Also: Soundboard matrix, through MC, C, DAT, CD, EAC and SHN, with a patch from the audience source; transferred by Darryl Hinko [1]
- **gd1988-04-14.sbd.miller.91248.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) D [2]. Also: Soundboard to cassette master, cassette, DAT, then CD; pitch correction was done with help from Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd1988-04-14.156481.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 16, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-XG90) [3]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several Ultramatrix masters were combined to make the show complete [3]
- **gd88-04-14.aud.willy.15824.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC*>DAT>CD [6]
